proof_body:
by
  intro a b c ha hD z
  have hs : ((Real.sqrt (4 * a * c - b ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 = 4 * a * c - b ^ 2 := by
    rw [← Complex.ofReal_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)]
    push_cast
    ring
  obtain ⟨s, hsdef⟩ : ∃ s : ℂ, s = ((Real.sqrt (4 * a * c - b ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hsdef] at hs ⊢
  have ha' : (a : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast ha
  have h2a : 2 * (a : ℂ) ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero ha'
  have hfac : 4 * (a : ℂ) * ((a : ℂ) * z ^ 2 + b * z + c) = (2 * a * z + b - s * Complex.I) * (2 * a * z + b + s * Complex.I) := by
    linear_combination -hs + s ^ 2 * Complex.I_sq
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [h, mul_zero] at hfac
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hfac.symm with h1 | h1
    · left
      rw [eq_div_iff h2a]
      linear_combination h1
    · right
      rw [eq_div_iff h2a]
      linear_combination h1
  · intro h
    have hp : (2 * a * z + b - s * Complex.I) * (2 * a * z + b + s * Complex.I) = 0 := by
      rcases h with h | h
      · have h1 : 2 * a * z + b - s * Complex.I = 0 := by
          rw [eq_div_iff h2a] at h
          linear_combination h
        rw [h1, zero_mul]
      · have h1 : 2 * a * z + b + s * Complex.I = 0 := by
          rw [eq_div_iff h2a] at h
          linear_combination h
        rw [h1, mul_zero]
    rw [hp] at hfac
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hfac).resolve_left (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) ha')
target_source: ∀ (a b c : ℝ), a ≠ 0 → b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c < 0 → ∀ z : ℂ, ((a : ℂ) * z ^ 2 + b * z + c = 0 ↔ z = (-(b : ℂ) + (Real.sqrt (4 * a * c - b ^ 2) : ℂ) * Complex.I) / (2 * a) ∨ z = (-(b : ℂ) - (Real.sqrt (4 * a * c - b ^ 2) : ℂ) * Complex.I) / (2 * a))
